title: Pressure and gravity study
summary: Separates two effects with the same burner. Variants change exactly one input: gravity (1 g, Mars 0.38 g, 0 g) at 1 atm, or pressure (0.5 atm) at 1 g.
expected_behaviour: Without gravity the buoyant plume disappears and the hot region becomes wider and shorter; lowering pressure lowers density and buoyant acceleration of the plume. Gravity does not enter the Level 1/2 models at all.
acceptance_checks: Peak axial velocity at 0 g is lower than at 1 g.
The acceleration plot shows the applied value for each variant.
